turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with who decided to give my son a zero, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
Does he. I didn't come here to be told what Owen says in class, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Don't manage me, Hale. Kind isn't why I'm here, and it isn't why the zero went in. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
No. You used the word "cheat", Hale, and I'm writing that down. My son doesn't lie, and I'm not agreeing to anything you haven't put in front of me. What do you actually have?
